tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo gser chos chig brgyud bzhugs so// nang gi rnal 'byor ma ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rtsa gsum gsal btab pa/ lus gdan sogs sngar bzhin byas pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i mas sna ru oṃ gyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mthe bong gi tshad tsam mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin gsal btab/ de mar me gcig las gcig chad kyi tshul gyis ro ma'i nang nas yar byon/ sna bug g.yas nas thon/ snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ tshur sna bug g.yon nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ yang sna bug g.yon nas spro bsdu sogs byas/ sna bug g.yas pa nas zhugs/ sngar ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de 'dra ba lan 'ga' re bya/ de nas ro ma zhabs g.yas pa la thim/ brkyang ma zhabs g.yon pa la thim/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i nang na yar byon pas/ rtsa dbu ma yang thung du song / spyi gtsug tshang sgo ru sleb/ mthar chos kyi dbyings su yal/ de'i ngang la sems mnyam par bzhag rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs dang / bskyed rim rab tu brtan pa dang / /zhes sogs shlau ka gcig dang / rdzogs rim rtags rnams myur gsal zhing / /zhes sogs shlau ka gcig lha mo tshad ma zhes sogs shlau ka gcig srid pa gsum 'bar sogs shlau ka gcig bkra shis gang zhig sogs shlau ka gcig dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis/ /zhes sogs dang / tsham ngam sngags kyi bsrung ba sogs mdzad cing bla ma'i phyag len mthong ba la'ang shes par bya'o/ /gsung 'di rnams bla ma'i gsung las/ snga mas steng du len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la phan pa'i bsam pas zur tsam bris pa dge'o/ maṅga laṃ// /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag bsam mi khyab kyi snying po 'di rje mus chen las sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thob pa yin// ༈ //rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma na ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub pa'i gser chos chig brgyud ma bzhugs so/

/༄༅/ /na maḥgu ru badzra yo gi ni ye/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams su/ rje btsun yab la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ yum la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ skye ba bdun pa'i sha la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i tshul dang gsum gsungs pa las/ 'di rtsa rgyud le'u zhe bdun par rnal 'byor ma'i nye snying la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs gsungs pa'i man ngag rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i don gyi bcud phyung ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis jo bo na ro ta pa la dngos su gsungs/ des bal po pham mthing pa sku mched las/ rgya bod kyi slob ma gzhan su la ma gnang ba'i gdams pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos rnams kyi nang nas ches zab pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma na ro mkha' spyod du grags pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas tshe 'dir mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs la/ thun mong du rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i sgom bzlas kyi sgo nas nyams su len tshul zhib par gsungs pa rnams yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yang zab kyi gdams pa snyan nas snyan dang / zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ rgyas par na ngag bzlas yid bzlas tshar rjes/ thun bsdus pa'i tshe bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshab tu/ 'di nyams su len pa yin la/ bsdus na rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus kyi drang por rtsa dbu ma padma'i rnam pa ltar phra ba/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til dmar gyi me ltar gsal ba ste chos bzhi dang ldan pa/ yar sna spyi gtsug tu zug par bsam/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ de gnyis ka sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam yas sna spyi gtsug nas sba gug ltar mdun phyogs su 'khyogs nas sna bug g.yas g.yon du zug pa/

rtsa gsum ka'ang mas sna lte bar slebs pa/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dzom par bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gcig bsam/ de la sems zhugs pa bzhin gtad pas de las chu las chu bur rdol pa ltar rnal 'byor ma chung ngu zhig nar gyis chad/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig tu me stag yar ba ltar rtsa g.yas ro ma'i nang na yar dmar khyug gis byon/ sna bug gi sgor slebs pa dang / de las de 'dra grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas skad cig nyid la tshur 'dus/ sna bug g.yon pa'i bu gar slebs pa dang / sngar 'phros pa'i rnal 'byor ma chung ngu me stag tsam de la thams cad thim/ de nyid rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig sna bug g.yon pa nas/ rtsa g.yon rkyang ma'i nang nas mar dmar khyug gis byon/ rlung nang du gnas pa dang / lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam zhing rlung ci thub bzung / de lta bu'i spro bsdu lan bdun nam gsum la sogs pa ci rigs pas lam sbyangs pa'i mthar/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yan lag rnams 'od du zhu nas lus kyi rdza ma la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od phung dmar por gyur/ de tsam na lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod la 'byon par chas nas steng phyogs su nar tsam nar tsam byon pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i dbu gtsug tu thim pas je thung du gyur/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis kyi mas sne'ang gyen du gug pas/ rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs mthil gnyis la 'byar ba gyen du 'then pas je thung du gyur/ de nas rim bzhin snying kha dang /

mgrin pa'i thad sogs su rnal 'byor ma byon/ rim gyis rtsa gsum yang de tsam 'dus/ lus kyi ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu 'ang smad nas rim bzhin yal nas der thim/ rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma spyi gtsug tu byon pa dang mnyam du rtsa gsum lus 'od phung dang bcas pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma la sib kyis thim/ de'i rkyen gyis rnal 'byor ma de nyid kyang nam mkha' la me stag yar ba'am/ rtsal po ches nam mkha' la mda' 'phangs pa ltar/ nam mkha'i dbyings blos mi 'khyud pa tsam na yar ye re re byon/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas su phebs pa dang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba'am/ du ba yal ba ltar chos sku stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam la/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar lus sems khong glod nas mnyam par 'jog /yang mkha' dbyings su rang sems rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa de nyid thol gyis byung / bya thur du bab pa lta bu byon nas rang gnas su byon/ phyi'i lus kyang sngar bzhin du grub par bsam la/ sngar kyi dmigs pa de nyid tshar nyer gcig gam bdun gsum la sogs pa skabs dang bstun pa bya'o/ /gdams pa 'di la chig dril du nyams len byas pas/ dus re zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos sam/ tha mal gyi bud med sha dang / mig dang skra dmar ser du yod pa zhig dang 'phrad nas/ des sgrub pa po'i lag pa'i 'khrig ma nas bzung ste/ dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su skad cig la khrid nas lus 'ja' lus su gyur/ longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang bsgyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas zhing du rgyu zhing dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /gal srid rnal 'byor sgrub pa po brtson 'grus chung pa sogs kyis tshe 'dir mkha' spyod ma 'grub na/ 'chi khar 'di nyid 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du nyams su blangs pas/ bar do med par mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no/

/'di nyid nyams len mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang mang po lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar ba ji snyed yod pas/ the tshom som nyi thams cad bral ba'i lam zab mo mthar thug pa 'di snying gi dkyil du gces pa bzung nas nyams len chig dril la brtson par bya'o/ /'di la ngor lugs kyi rjes 'brangs rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung zhes zer/ sa skya rdzong chung pa rnams nang gi rnal 'byor ma zhes zer/ 'di pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag ces brjod/ 'di ding sang gi bar du gser gyi maṇḍal nges pa can dang bcas te gdan thog gcig tu chig brgyud las mang ba mi ster ba'i bka' rgya dang / dam dog shin tu che bar mdzad pa yin no/ /'on kyang gsung bgros tshad ldan zin pa'i zin bris kha cig tu/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor byas nas 'di nyid bsgom pa dang / rang sems rnal 'byor ma nam mkhar byon pa la 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs byed pa dang / rang lus dor nas 'jog pa sogs ni/ gdams pa 'di nyid bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa yin tshul sogs kyi gnad ye ma go ba'i bab col du snang bas mchil ma'i thal ba ltar ring du dor bar bya'o/ /kha cig 'di nyid la rgyun gyi nyams len chig dril byas na/ 'pho rab tshe thung zer bas mi rung snyam/ 'di ni lus sems phral ba'i 'pho tshul ma yin/ bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ces bya ba bskyed rim gyi nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor yin pas 'gal ba cung zad kyang med ces rje bla ma'i gsung las thos so/ /rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye ba'i lam/ /sdig can thar mchog bsgrod pa'i gsang lam mchog /na ro ta pa'i chig brgyud snying gi gtam/ /sa skya'i bla chen brgyud pa'i gser chos 'di/ /snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang / /kun spangs chos rje'i zhal las thos gyur nas/

/sngon chad yi ge med cing snying la bcang / /yid ches nyams len mchog gi rjes su bskyangs/ /da lan rigs kyi tsha bo snying gi bu/ /skal bzang mi dbang rdo rje rin chen zhes/ /yid gcugs gzhon nu de la lhug par bstan/ /snyan brgyud zab mo yi ge'i ris su bkod/ /mthong thos yig rul bsdus pa'i bab col min/ /mkhas 'dod rang bzos bslad pa'i zog chos min/ /grub mchog brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gsung / /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams 'di nyid yin/ /snying nas gces pa'i nyams len brtson par mdzod/ /nam zhig sgyu ma'i skyes chen 'degs pa'i tshe/ /rang sems skye med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du yud kyis spor/ /drin can bla ma'i thugs kar rgyangs kyis 'phos/ /de skad snyan brgyud yi ger bkod pa la/ /bla ma mchog dang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis dbyings nas bzod mdzod la/ /bdag dang skal bzang bu la grub gnyis stsol/ /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i bandhe blo gsal gyis 'phan yul ba'i sman ljongs u ṭi ya na'i ming can gyi gzhis kar/ mi dbang gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dpal bzang po la snying nas gdams pa'i zab chos gu hya sa mā ya/ shu bham̐/ 'di'i lung spyan snga rin po che'i drung du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thob/ yang rje tshar chen gyis mkhyen brtse ba la gnang / des rje bslab gsum rgyal mtshan la/ des grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan la gnang / des bdag sa skya pa ā nanda pu ṇya la gnang ba phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis/ man ngag gi dpe 'di la tshig sna ring thung 'ga' re 'dug pa bla ma'i phyag dpe la gtugs nas sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis zhus dag bgyis pa'o// ༈ //shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten nas btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas sngon du btang nas/ yi dam gyi lha la tshogs gtor phul/ slob ma rnams khrus legs par byas te/ slob ma'i spyi bor bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i rnal 'byor ma gsal btab/ gus 'dud drag po'i sgo nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag 'dzin blo yis thong par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar༞ lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong par༞ 'phyug med mkha' spyod 'grub par༞ zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gcig gsal btab/ de'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa a dkar po 'phigs 'gro la khad/ gcig gsal btab/ a de las zug pa'i rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug 'bring po tsam spyi bo na yar song / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas la zug par bsam/ yang phaṭ gcig brjod pas rang gi thod pa bog ste/ mdun du dpral ba rang la bstan pa kha gyen du bstan la bzhag yang brjod pas lte ba yan chad kyi lus thod pa'i nang du lhung bar bsam/ yang phaṭ gcig brjod pas thod pa'i rdzas de ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs par bsam nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsol pas/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od kyi ba thag dkar po dbu ma'i nang da mar skya nar byung / lte ba na gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po de la zug rlung phyir ldang ba dang bstun te ngag tu hik brjod pas/ a dkar po de'i 'od kyi sna la khyer te dbu ma'i nang nas song ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la gnyis med du 'dres/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun/ ka zhes brjod pa dang bstun te/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od kyi ba thag dang bcas pa byung ste lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du gnas/

de lta bu'i 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du sbyangs/ de nas lus po sngar bzhin med song bar bsam/ las la sbyor dus yar spar mar 'bebs pa de mi byed do/ /dge ba 'di sogs smon lam btab/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ des bdag snyoms las pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang la'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis/ bla ma dang mkha' spyod ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres/ rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du byon par bsam gsung ngo // ༈ //rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma'i dris lan dogs dpyod zin bris bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma bsgom par 'dod pas rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mjug bde stong gi ngang nas skur lang ste bsgom pa yin gsungs pa/ spyir der skabs su sku rgyan dang phyag mtshan med par lang par bshad pa bzhin/ 'pho ba bsgom pa'i tshe yang sku rgyan med du lang pas chog gam rgyan bcas su lang dgos/ de'i tshe rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byams pa khyel bzhugs kyi rnam par bsgom pa'i gsang gnas la/ rang gi tshangs bug nas 'thon pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i yas sna zug par bsgom dgos par gsungs pa'i dbu ma de kha dog ji ltar du bsgom dgos/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo a bsam rgyu de chung yig tu bsam pas chog gam che yig tu bsam dgos/ phaṭ gsum dang hik ka rnams la skad che chung ji ltar bya/ rang gi lus lte ba yan chad mchod par phul ba'i lhag ma de mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las 'pho ba bsgom grub 'phral rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur lang nas oṃ ha na ma hi sogs dang / tsham rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba dang / hūm̐ gcig brjod pas sku'i dga' ba/ rkang brgyad brjod pas gsung gi dga' ba/

yang hūm̐ gcig brjod pas thugs kyi dga' ba dang / de nas bsngo ba smon lam rnams byed par gsungs pa'i/ las sbyor gyi skabs min pa'i da lta 'pho ba sbyong ba'i tshe rnams su/ rang gi spyi bor bsgoms pa'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de mi dmigs par bsam mam rang la thim par bsam/ 'di rnams la yid gnyis kyi dra ba gcad du gsol/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ bla ma rnal 'byor ma rgyan can du bsgom dgos shing / rang rgyan yod med gang byas kyang chog la/ dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar bar bsgom zhing / phaṭ gsum dang hik ka gnyis rang gis tshor tsam gyis chog la/ rnam shes kyi ngo bo a bsam rgyu de che yig yin zhing / 'pho ba sbyong dus kyi bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang la bstim rgyu yin lags/ 'dis rab ni mkha' spyod chen po thob/ de ma thob na chung ngu nges par thob/ de'i yon tan ni/ lha'i lus lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ skra sil bur gnas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ tshe nyi zla nam gnas kyi bar du thub pa/ sprul sku las chos nyan nus pa/ tshe de la sangs rgya nges pa gcig yin/ zhes pa 'di rje mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong ā nandas gling kha bsam gtan phug gi rje dam pa'i gzim phug gi mdor rje'i zhabs drung nyid du bris pa'o// //༅/ /rtsa ro ma la brten pa'i yi ge bzhi /rkyang ma la brten pa'i yi ge lnga/ dbu ma la brten pa'i yi ge bzhi/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdo'i yi ge 'bru gcig ste bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi'o/ /lte ba'i lkog sor bzhi nas dbu ma'i rgyun zad do/ /rtsa ro rkyang dbu ma/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi rnams kyi dbyibs tshul bkod pa 'di ni sems la gzung 'dzin gyi dbang gis rigs drug gi bag chags bzhag pa/ lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du yod pa rnams dbye shes pa'i phyir du dpe ris rnying ma dag las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/

rgyas bshad ngag las btsal bar bya zhing / rtsa gsum gyi mas sne 'dzoms pa'i bam̐ yig 'di ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mtshon byed yin pas/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi mas sna gug pa dang / rtsa dbu ma'i nang du bam̐ yig gi mgo bo bstan pa rnams ni/ gong gi man ngag zab mo'i bsgom don gyi dpe ris yin par shes dgos so/ /dge'o// //dud 'gro du ser nag zung 'jug gi hūm̐ sngon po/ dmyal ba'i tri nag po/ phyi dbyibs kyi a dkar po/ lha'i a dkar po/ lha min gyi su ser po/ bsam gtan gyi oṃ dkar po/ shes rab kyi a dkar po/ mi'i ṇi sngon po/ yi dwags kyi pre dmar po/ snying po'i a shad dkar po/ stobs kyi hūm̐ sngon po/ srin bu'i kṣa ljang khu/ drag po'i phaṭ dmar nag rtsa gsum gyi dpe ris shig 'dug pas de'i nang gi srog yig rnams/ /a oṃ ṇi/ du hūm̐ tri a/ su a pre/ bam̐ hūm̐ kṣa phaṭ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 a myes zhabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo gser chos chig brgyud/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
